source.snippet: There have been previous outages that last 1-2 days, but I haven't been able to get RSS feeds from YouTube for the last 4 days now. This goes for new channels and previous channels in a feed reader; Google displays a 404 page no matter what.

problem_statement: YouTube RSS feed endpoints periodically return 404 errors for days at a time, breaking automated content pipelines, newsletter curation workflows, and feed-reader setups that depend on reliable YouTube channel monitoring.
target_segment: Newsletter operators, content curators, podcast producers, and developers who build automations on top of YouTube RSS feeds for content monitoring and aggregation.
notes: Recurring platform instability (commenter notes 'previous outages' lasting 1-2 days, now 4 days). Newsletter operators and content aggregators have demonstrated WTP for reliable data pipelines (e.g., Feedly Pro, Inoreader paid plans). A paid YouTube channel monitoring / RSS proxy service would address this. Signal is moderate — one HN comment, but describes repeated outages suggesting chronic pain.
